title: Day 10: The Night Shift

voices.dez: designed: male, elderly, very low pitch

ctaComment: A, B or the secret C? 🔒👇

lines: Day ten. You voted B... the part-time job. Big Mike's Burgers. Twelve dollars an hour.
chunks.text: Day ten. You voted B... the part-time job. Big Mike's Burgers. Twelve dollars an hour.

lines: You're late, rookie. Grill. Fries. Mop. Move it!
First shift. Ten hours. Grease everywhere.
chunks.text: You're late, rookie. Grill. Fries. Mop. Move it! First shift. Ten hours. Grease everywhere.

lines: Between orders I juggled a balled-up napkin. Lana waited by the window all day.
chunks.text: Between orders I juggled a balled-up napkin. Lana waited by the window all day.

lines: Yo, new guy. You juggle like you actually play. Midnight. The cage. Five-a-side.
chunks.text: Then a coworker caught me. Yo, new guy. You juggle like you actually play. Midnight. The cage. Five-a-side.

lines: After my shift, Dez trained me under the streetlight. From above, every cone was a defender.
chunks.text: After my shift, Dez trained me under the streetlight. From above, every cone was a defender.

lines: Tired legs teach you the most. Again.
Down low, all I could see was the ball.
chunks.text: Tired legs teach you the most. Again. Down low, all I could see was the ball.

lines: Midnight. The cage. Tasha's crew versus the Night Owls. First to three.
chunks.text: Midnight. The cage. Tasha's crew versus the Night Owls. First to three.

lines: Kick off. They scored first. Fast.
chunks.text: Kick off. They scored first. Fast.

lines: Then I saw it from above... the gap behind their defender.
chunks.text: Then I saw it from above... the gap behind their defender.

lines: Weak foot. Just like Dez taught me.
chunks.text: Weak foot. Just like Dez taught me.
Next goal wins.
Watch it again.

lines: You're on the team, new guy.
And the cage pays winners. Forty dollars each.
chunks.text: You're on the team, new guy. And the cage pays winners. Forty dollars each.

lines: Paycheck plus prize: three hundred fifty-eight dollars. Still eight hundred forty-two short.

lines: Card check. Physical: thirty to thirty-four. Dribbling: thirty-four to thirty-seven. Overall... thirty-four!
